prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a production PBR wood ALBEDO color texture for a Three.js theatrical wooden box, wooden folding fan ribs and bamboo/wood umbrella framework.
Primary request: Generate one exceptionally realistic, high-resolution square 1:1 image filled edge to edge with a single continuous natural wood surface. The material is unvarnished finely sanded warm honey walnut-brown timber, showing subtle organic long longitudinal fibres running VERTICALLY from top to bottom, irregular fine annual-ring streaks, delicate variations in warm brown and muted golden tan, microscopic pores, and only a very small number of tiny subdued knots. Photographic scanned material appearance at close range, not an illustration or stylized procedural texture.
Composition: Orthographic view directly perpendicular to the wood surface. The entire image is ONLY the wood texture; no board edges, no planks, no panel divisions, no joined strips, no border, no background, no objects. Aim for seamless tiling along all four edges; avoid any obvious dominant motif. Grain must be naturally fine, unevenly spaced, irregular and mostly straight with gentle occasional changes in direction. Knots must be small, subtle and sparse.
Lighting: perfectly even diffuse neutral illumination, suitable as an albedo map; no cast shadows, no directional lighting gradient, no specular highlights, no reflections, no vignette, no baked ambient occlusion.
Color palette: warm medium honey-brown and walnut-brown, restrained natural contrast, fine lighter growth fibres and darker pores. Preserve realistic tonal detail without oversaturation.
Avoid: large bold waves, regular equally spaced stripes, black cracks, dramatic high contrast rings, giant knots, cartoon wood, painted or vector texture, woven fabric, plywood layers, end grain, parquet, plank seams, product photography, perspective, logos, letters, text, watermark.
Output: opaque high-resolution square raster texture, preferably 2048 by 2048.
visual_review: Full-frame warm honey/walnut wood with fine irregular vertical fibres, subtle natural pores and two very small subdued knots. No text, board edges, seams, backdrop or obvious directional lighting. Designed for tiling; exact seamless edge continuity has not been certified.
